text:
Maya P: quick heads-up — finalizing assets for the observability tile we demo with EdgeCompute (HW SI). Need: OTLP exporter sample, 2 dashboards (health + latency), and a short demo script. Target marketplace submission next Tue. Who owns packaging?
Raj K: I can take packaging. will need the otel config and sample traces. pinged eng-ml for kv cache traces. ETA EOD Fri.
Sophie L: I'll own the dashboards and screenshots. Do we want EU localization for market listing? Kenji?
Kenji T: yes, JP + EU preferred by partner. I can help localize dashboard labels and write Japanese copy. timezone note: partner demo window 4/10 09:00 JST.
Ethan Z: from eng-runtime: confirm OTLP exporter must support gRPC and HTTP; quantized models don't change telemetry. attaching a quick config:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
exporters:
  logging:
  datadog:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [logging, datadog]
```
Maya P: perfect — Sophie can you add localized screenshots + copy by Mon? Kenji pls pair for JP copy.
Sophie L: yup, adding to the drive now. will include alt text for screenshots.
Raj K: packaging note: marketplace wants a single tarball + install script. i'll draft install.sh and a small smoke test that hits /metrics and /health.
Maya P: legal/comms: embargo until partner ok. @Ethan Z can we add an env var switch to enable demo traces so we don't pollute prod telemetry?
Ethan Z: yep — DEMO_TRACES=true gate. will add to runtime flag matrix and add to release notes.
deploy-bot: staging bundle built: sb-202311-879, deployed to staging-obs-03. smoke tests: 6/6 passed.
Maya P: awesome. next steps: 1) Sophie localize by Mon, 2) Raj packaging by Fri, 3) Ethan flag + demo traces by Thu, 4) Kenji confirm JP copy + demo time. I'll schedule a dry-run with partner for 4/9. thanks all :rocket: 
Kenji T: will confirm demo time by EOD.
Sophie L: drive link: https://drive.redwood.co/obs-edgecompute/tile-assets
Maya P: adding this thread to the marketplace checklist doc.
